u0: Initial subtask: the blocking ball still occupies the only reachable cell in front of the locked door, so the door cannot be reached or opened. Next objective: clear this blocker by picking up the ball and moving it away from the door-front cell, which triggers blocker_moved and advances to u1. Do not pick up the matching key first unless you can avoid dropping it while the door remains closed; such a drop triggers key_lost and failure.
u1: Blocker-cleared progress: the ball has been removed from the door-front cell at least once, but the matching key is not yet held while that access remains clear. Next objective: keep the blocker away and pick up the key whose color matches the door so has_door_key and blocker_moved hold together, advancing to u2. Do not drop a carried matching key while the door is still closed; that triggers key_lost and failure.
u2: Key-ready progress: the matching key is carried and the blocker is out of the door-front cell, but the door is still closed. Next objective: reach the door and toggle it open to trigger door_open and advance to u3. Keep holding the matching key until the door is open; dropping it now while the door is closed triggers key_lost and failure.
u3: Door-open progress: the door to the target room has been unlocked and opened, and the mission's designated target box has not yet been picked up. Next objective: enter the far room, free your hands if still carrying the key since dropping it is safe while the door is open, and pick up the mission-named box to trigger target_picked_up and finish. Only picking up the designated box is terminal success.
u4: Terminal success: the agent is carrying the mission's designated target box, so the episode ends immediately with the mission complete. There is no further subtask or action to take.
u5: Absorbing failure state: the matching key was acquired and then dropped before the door was opened, firing key_lost and violating the task. No later transition earns reward, and reacquiring the key cannot recover within the Reward Machine. This is a failure sink rather than a successful terminal state; the environment may continue, but the run has failed.
